description: Retrieve lists in a space (folderless) or in a folder. Requires space_id/space_name OR folder_id/folder_name.

detail_level.description: Controls response verbosity. 'names' returns id/name only for efficient navigation. 'detailed' returns full metadata. Default: detailed.

folder_id.description: Folder ID — returns lists inside this folder (preferred over folder_name).

folder_name.description: Folder name (alternative to folder_id; requires space_id or space_name to resolve).

space_id.description: Space ID — returns folderless lists in this space.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: list_lists
